SIP RFC 7544 / RFC 6406 IMS NNI Peering: IBCF Topology Hiding, P-Header Scrub & BGF c= Anchor
P963 IBCF Single-Via Topology Hiding & P-Access-Network-Info Scrub · P964 BGF Public SDP c= Rewrite & [5, 200] CPS Trunk Cap
❌ Unprotected Carrier NNI Peering Trunk Risks
1. Internal P-Header & Multi-Hop Via Topology Bleed (RFC 7544)
• Forwards P-Access-Network-Info (cell cgi-3gpp / Wi-Fi BSSID)
• Exposes P-Associated-URI, Service-Route & 5 internal Via IPs
• Enables external topology mapping and subscriber alias harvesting
2. Unanchored RFC 1918 SDP c= Line & Uncapped Peering CPS
• Leaks pod IP c=IN IP4 10.244.18.9 into carrier NNI SDP Offer
• Carrier RTP blackholes on private IP → 100% one-way dead air
• Uncapped 1,500 CPS peering flood exhausts AI ASR/LLM GPU workers
Enterprise Production Impact (Without P963–P964)
• Internal K8s Voice Pod IPs & cell-tower IDs leaked to third parties
• Carrier interconnects drop RTP audio or trigger GPU starvation
Verdict: BLOCK (NNI Topology Leak / Private SDP c= Blackhole)
✅ Deterministic IMS NNI & BGF Peering Guards (P963–P964)
P963: IBCF NNI Header Sanitization & Single-Via Topology Hiding
• Strip P-Access-Network-Info, P-Associated-URI, Path, Service-Route
• Collapse internal Via / Record-Route stack to 1 IBCF edge hop
• Tokenize Call-ID across untrusted NNI peering boundary
• leakedInternalNniHeaders == 0 & exposedNniViaHops == 1
• Gate: evaluateSipRfc7544ImsNniPeeringHeaderSanitization...()
P964: BGF Public SDP c= Anchor Rewrite & [5, 200] CPS Trunk Cap
• Block RFC 1918 / loopback / link-local IPs in NNI SDP c= lines
• Force BGF public media anchor rewrite on all cross-carrier legs
• Clamp per-trunk peering INVITE rate in [5, 200] CPS token bucket
• unanchoredPrivateClineOrPeeringStormDrops == 0
• Gate: evaluateSipRfc7544BgfMediaConnectionAddressRewrite...()
Verdict: PASS (0 Leaked NNI Headers · 100% BGF Anchor · 927 Tests)
